import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from tools.sloppy_core.benchmark_apps import prepare_clock

root = Path.cwd()
state = json.loads((root/'__dewycache__/compact-core/current.json').read_text())
compiler = root/'__dewycache__/compact-core'/state['binary']
directory = Path('/tmp/dewy-source-core/range-index-benchmark')
directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2(root/'tools/sloppy_core/benchmark_harness.jo', directory/'benchmark_harness.jo')
clock_hashes = prepare_clock(directory, 'thread-cpu')
count = 1000000
rounds = 20
expected = rounds*(count-2) + rounds*(rounds-1)
source_template = '''from p"benchmark_harness.jo" import clock
kernel=(values:array<int64> indices:INDEX_TYPE):>int64=>{
let checksum:int64=0
loop round in [0..ROUNDS) {
    let picked=values[indices]
    checksum+=picked[round]+picked[picked.length-1]
}
return checksum
}
main=():>void=>{
let values=[loop i in [0..COUNT) i]
let indices=INDICES
if kernel(values indices) not=? EXPECTED panic("warmup checksum")
let started=clock() let checksum=kernel(values indices) let elapsed=clock()-started
printl"{checksum} {elapsed}"
}
'''
variants={'range':('IntRange',f'[0,2..{count})'),
          'index_array':('array<int64>',f'[loop i in [0,2..{count}) i]')}
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('DEWY_', 'SLOPPY_'))}
env['SLOPPY_EMIT_WORKERS']='1'
report={'toolchain':state,'count':count,'rounds':rounds,'samples':7,
        'clock':'Linux thread CPU','expected_checksum':expected,'harness_sha256':clock_hashes,
        'load_start':os.getloadavg(),'variants':{},
        'scope':'Both index selections are constructed before timing. Each kernel materializes 20 half-size arrays; output allocations are included. Range bounds are checked once per selection. No source-array construction or index-array construction is timed.'}
for name,(kind,indices) in variants.items():
    source=source_template.replace('INDEX_TYPE',kind).replace('INDICES',indices).replace('COUNT',str(count)).replace('ROUNDS',str(rounds)).replace('EXPECTED',str(expected))
    path=directory/f'{name}.dewy'
    path.write_text(source)
    binary=directory/name
    start=time.perf_counter()
    built=subprocess.run([str(compiler),'build',str(path),'--release','-o',str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=30)
    if built.returncode: raise RuntimeError(built.stdout+built.stderr)
    report['variants'][name]={'source':source,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'build_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'kernel_ns':[],'wall_seconds':[]}
for sample in range(8):
    names=list(variants)
    if sample%2: names.reverse()
    for name in names:
        start=time.perf_counter()
        ran=subprocess.run([str(directory/name)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30,env=env)
        wall=time.perf_counter()-start
        if ran.returncode: raise RuntimeError(ran.stdout+ran.stderr)
        checksum,elapsed=map(int,ran.stdout.split())
        if checksum != expected: raise RuntimeError(f'{name} checksum {checksum}, expected {expected}')
        if sample:
            report['variants'][name]['kernel_ns'].append(elapsed)
            report['variants'][name]['wall_seconds'].append(wall)
for name,results in report['variants'].items():
    results['median_kernel_ms']=statistics.median(results['kernel_ns'])/1e6
    print(name,results['median_kernel_ms'],'ms CPU')
report['median_paired_ratio']=statistics.median(a/b for a,b in zip(report['variants']['range']['kernel_ns'],report['variants']['index_array']['kernel_ns']))
report['load_end']=os.getloadavg()
report['script']=Path(__file__).read_text()
Path('/tmp/dewy-source-core/range-index-runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('paired range/index-array ratio',report['median_paired_ratio'])
